senses.gloss: (b. h.; Pilp. of חָרַר III)to set twigs on fire for driving out the bees.
units: Ukts. III, 11 משיְחַרְחֵר from the moment he smokes the bees out; [Maim.: he heats the honey-comb; Var. in Ar.: משיְהַרְהֵר].
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:13">Cant. R. to VIII, 13</cite> <he>ולא תְחַרְתֲרוּ זה עם זה</he> do not quarrel with one another.
